text.content:
The online version keeps the book's numbers for you: it rolls the dice, applies damage, Vigour and Chi, runs the enemies' step and keeps the clocks. Each step posts a card saying what happened and why, so the table can check it against the book. When the book and the online version disagree, the book is right.

Before the first night (Storyteller)

  1. Fighters. Import the five from the Ready-made Fighters compendium, or create Actors of type Fighter and choose four picks each: an element, a fighting style, a perk and an Awakening. No two fighters in a group share any pick.
  2. Owners. Give each player Owner permission on their fighter. Players use their own fighter's sheet; the Storyteller can act for anyone.
  3. Art. Click a portrait on any sheet to choose a picture. A fighter with no picture shows their element's badge. Tokens are linked to their actors, so Vigour and Toughness bars follow the sheets.

Running the night

Open The Night from the button at the top of the Actors tab. Its top line always says what comes next.

  1. Begin the night. Pick the difficulty and three to five fighters. Everyone's Vigour and Chi are set from the size table. To use Anchors of your own (Chapter 9), press Name the Anchors first; each Anchor keeps one Shell element.
  2. The Prologue, then The First Clash. Starting a fight makes its enemies (a Pack of Stills, and the Warden or the Heart) and puts them in the Actors tab. Drag them onto a scene if you want tokens; the fight doesn't need a map.
  3. The Hunt. Each Hour, press Go beside an Anchor or Take a Respite. The Night sheet counts the Hours, long fights and any Hour owed.
  4. The Heart. When the Hunt is over, press The Heart. Dawn comes at the end of the round shown.

A round

  • Fighters act from their sheets, in any order the players like: Strike, Rally, Awaken, or Hold the Seal. The Strike window offers the Chi die, your technique and Help from allies who have Chi; the helper's Chi is spent for them. Quick fighters get Quick: free Strike before round 1.
  • End the round on the Night sheet: Awakenings count down, the enemies take their step (drawing on their Stills, the Swarm and the Surge), and the clocks are checked. At an Anchor you can End the round and withdraw.
  • Guardian. When a Guardian could take a loss, the Storyteller is asked first.
  • By hand. Click a pip on a sheet to set Vigour or Chi; clicking the top lit pip takes one away. Use it for rulings and mistakes.

Settings

Under the system settings, each automation can be switched off. The cards still say what the book says; you apply it by hand.

  • Apply Strike results: damage, Vigour, Chi, Shells and Help.
  • Run the enemies' step: drawing on Stills, the Swarm and the Surge.
  • Keep the clocks: Hours, long fights, the round-7 limit and dawn.
  • Ask about the Guardian: the prompt when a Guardian could take a loss.

If something goes wrong

  • Nothing happens when a player presses a button: the Storyteller must be connected, because every result is worked out on the Storyteller's side.
  • A wrong result: fix it on the sheets by hand and carry on. The cards keep a record of every step.
